description: Evidence-required completion plus a test-modification guard. post-bash writes a verification stamp when a test or build command passes; edit-tracker clears it when a file changes; verify-gate refuses a commit without a fresh one; guard-test-changes refuses to modify an existing test or test config without a declaration naming it. The stamp trio resolves through stamp-path.sh; the guard classifies paths through classify-test-paths.sh. check-test-changes.sh is the CI half of the guard and is invoked by your workflow, not by a hook. Naming convention: implementation files are named for what they do; every file named test-* is a control suite and nothing else.
